        <section class="content article-content mb-6" itemprop="articleBody">
          <p>Follow this article to receive email notifications when content is added to Optimizely Opal for 2026.</p><h2 id="h_01KSJMXV0N3QE3JFVMQYT1Z90Q">June 30<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KSJMXV0N3QE3JFVMQYT1Z90Q"></a></h2><h4 id="h_01KWCK21JXWZC7QGY4BNPBNPS9">Opal Agent Usage dashboard</h4><ul><li data-list-item-id="e4fece7d5e17f43de4ce12f5badcf974c">Released a new version of the <strong>Opal Agent Usage</strong> dashboard, which gives organizations a centralized dashboard for Opal agent usage so administrators can track executions, monitor credit consumption, and see which agents and users are most active. The updated dashboard displays summary cards, an execution-type breakdown, agent and top-user tables, and weekly active-user trends over your selected time period. See <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/40917478334093-Optimizely-Reporting-for-Opal" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Optimizely Reporting for Opal</a> for more information.</li></ul><h4 id="h_01KWCGPR2H5MS2PQAT98QY05VC">Opal platform</h4><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e1bc5b8abc819b607692b058c0570e3a2">Released the <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46841075475853-Agent-Library" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Agent Library</a>, a browsable catalog on the Opal Chat homepage where you can find and launch more than 45 pre-built agents in one click, so discovering the right agent no longer means knowing where to look.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed478dd077617e9a888b30c8a2b7cb76d">Released <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46923254602253" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Personalize Opal</a>, a pinned onboarding agent that walks you through connecting your tools and building skills in a guided, role-based session, so you get value from Chat in your first few minutes.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef7b9607b0d3173ed378de1bb9554cfd7">Added agent sharing and visibility controls, which let you keep an agent private or share it with named people or your whole organization, with permission levels that govern who can view, run, edit, or delete each agent. New agents default to private on instances where the feature is enabled (not available on all tiers). See <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46955665143309-Share-agents-and-manage-visibility" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Share agents and manage visibility</a>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6723eba935574e254194f52b887e3390">Released an image editor in Opal Chat, which lets you refine a generated image without starting over by detecting and selecting visual elements, transforming them with brush controls, queuing batch edits, and applying smart aspect ratios, so you generate and fine-tune images in one place. See <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46923547617421-Image-generation" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Image generation</a>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec7625057268cb27dd2067e1e656ceb65">Released the <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46215744677133-Skills-builder" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Skills builder</a> for general availability, which lets you create and manage reusable skills that agents draw on, so you tailor Opal to your own workflows.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4584c33002d82f4a860649fb90fb6412">Added the ability to export workflow agent execution logs to comma-separated values (CSV) or Excel with date-range filtering, and added the same date-range selection to specialized agent log exports, so you can pull an audit trail on demand for performance tracking and compliance. See <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43421534871949-Workflow-agent-logs" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Workflow agent logs</a> and <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43420950339725-Specialized-agent-logs" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Specialized agent logs</a>.</li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KWCGPR2K93MS76KV2B0VYN6D">Agents</h4><p>Released the following agents:</p><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eed84766d18ca66b3fcc59e35bfa1624c">
<a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46747885873421-Meeting-Notes-Summary-agent" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Meeting Notes Summary agent</a> – Turns raw notes or a transcript into a shareable one-page summary of decisions, owner-assigned action items, and open questions, so nothing from a meeting gets lost.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9509407c1a3b0a9ae361c843ea769221">
<a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/47000128111629-Meeting-Follow-up-Email-agent" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Meeting Follow-up Email agent</a> – Turns meeting notes into a ready-to-send email covering decisions, action items with named owners, and next steps, so you send a clear recap in minutes.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5fc35e889eb951baefa3fbdd0939f2f4">
<a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/47000357635725-Meeting-Preparation-agent" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Meeting Preparation agent</a> – Turns your agenda, prior notes, and attendees into a one-page brief you can read in under two minutes, covering the goal, key context, talking points, and decisions to make, so you walk in prepared.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4d656e9151432997d9337d08cced47ba">
<a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46960991126029-Newsletter-Body-Editor-agent" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Newsletter Body Editor agent</a> – Drafts engaging email body copy from a topic, audience, and brand voice, so you go from brief to on-brand draft in one step. See </li>
<li data-list-item-id="e87fd6d4b6207871de7fddb2feaacaedc">
<a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46944502030861-Email-Ideation-agent" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Email Ideation agent</a> –  Brainstorms five to seven newsletter themes and content angles tailored to your niche and goals, so you start from ideas instead of a blank brief.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec4a2a0588c68cc5ec4928e8b28826dcf">
<a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46944544517901" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Email Subject and Preview Text Generation agent</a> – Generates paired subject lines and preview text optimized for specific psychological triggers, so you have ready-to-test copy that can lift open rates. </li>

The Quality tab contains the following three features:</p><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb0b07c88525878d7cec3c6a25a9fa79a">
<strong>Output Evaluation</strong> uses an AI model to score each run against criteria you define. Configure up to 10 evaluation criteria and a baseline evaluation score between 75% and 95% in 5% increments. Provide up to five output examples or conversation samples that represent expected quality.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edca2fd2c628c5b268e8dbdf49440fc5f">
<strong>Execution Guardrails</strong> detect runs that deviate from your agent's normal behavior. The guardrails progress through Learning, Watching, and Enforcing modes based on successful runs observed. You control sensitivity and whether Opal stops flagged runs automatically.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb0a4cdebfe63bce5124422fe08e1eb7c">
<strong>Execution Advisor</strong> recovers flagged runs with corrective guidance and retries failed tool calls with adjusted input. It also reviews sensitive tool calls (such as email, publish, or delete) with inline <strong>Approved</strong> or <strong>Blocked</strong> verdicts.</li>
</ul><p>See <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46195603210125-Quality-tab-overview" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Quality tab overview</a> for details.</p><h2 id="h_01KT24MT9CRT1BY12JG736MRAX">May 27<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KT24MT9CRT1BY12JG736MRAX"></a></h2><p>Added a <strong>Skills</strong> section to the specialized agent edit and create pages. <li data-list-item-id="e2c101f1f61db9fabaf8f851859d98da0">Released the <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/42860818044557" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Crunchbase connector tools</a> in Opal, which provide AI-powered access to the world's most comprehensive dataset of companies, investors, funding rounds, and key business personnel.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0813214b37c870eadaac16ccfbbc1cda">Released the <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/42861341195277" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Zoom Webinar connector tools </a>in Opal, which let you summarize webinar transcripts, get and update webinar details, and get poll results.</li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KG04EMRZ5X639ZCKB6KPJYS2">CMS (SaaS) tools</h4><p>Released the following tools in Opal to help you manage your CMS (SaaS) content. See <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39682866313613-System-tools-for-Content-Management-System-CMS#h_01K5W7KQH9AZFNNDSP00KNA0DG" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Content items section in the System tools for Content Management System (CMS) documentation </a>for more information.</p><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb3f8c9132d54639c1acf270fb9df989d">
<code>cms_create_content_item</code> – Creates a new empty content instance in CMS (SaaS) based on an existing content type.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eadd80306100b6b04c3c0ac79aa0ee05c">
<code>cms_get_content_data</code> – Retrieves CMS (SaaS) content data for a specific content item.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3ba9259da1bb440c635b99af24744b00">
<code>cms_delete_content_item</code> – Deletes a content item from CMS (SaaS) using its unique content key</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4e8c978c451cd1b17ea290dd1d67b791">
<code>cms_publish_content_item</code> – Publishes a specific content version in CMS (SaaS), making it visible to site visitors.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef75795f2f298d29c830674b6571ab37c">
<code>cms_update_content_item</code> – Updates the value for any property of a content item using a "JSON Merge Patch" algorithm.</li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KG7Z7544JEMA20P5Z03ARFE2">Optimizely Graph tools</h4><p>Released the following tools in Opal to help you manage your <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/43110435569805" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Optimizely Graph</a> content in <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39682866313613#h_01KG7YGAGGQ87SR099NPTRB9E2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">CMS (SaaS)</a> and CMS 12.</p><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e7b2b2cf4e69f52d290484448aeb81e2f">
<code>graph_content_type_schema</code> – Your starting point to understand the content structure within your Optimizely Graph instance. The tool lets you and Opal discover available content types and their fields, which is crucial for constructing accurate GraphQL queries.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eaf4e40133fcdb1d0cd16df5918541e9d">
<code>graph_content_graphql_executor</code> – Lets you execute custom GraphQL queries against your Optimizely Graph instance. You can retrieve specific content items, filter results, sort, and get aggregated data (facets).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef7f2080047dc697b6f207a3d0725ccad">
<code>graph_content_search_tool</code> – Use as a simpler alternative for searching content in Optimizely Graph when constructing complex GraphQL queries might be excessive. It lets you search for content based on a search phrase across a specified content type.</li>
</ul><h2 id="h_01KFXW869DHN8RPP5DB2J7PB38">January 22<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KFXW869DHN8RPP5DB2J7PB38"></a></h2><h4 id="h_01KFKM0KDKDF7ANZ6DFG4Y8V0G">Personalization</h4><p>Released the following <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/42821067294093" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">system tools in Optimizely Opal</a> to help you with your Personalization projects:</p><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e419c709d85004573163c0227222e035b">
<code>exp_get_schemas</code> – Retrieves detailed schemas for various Optimizely entities relevant to Personalization. This is a mandatory first step before using the <code>exp_execute_query</code> tool to retrieve actual data about these entities.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2f999fb08dd60c191e942d8d24e4f730">
<code>exp_execute_query</code> – Executes a template-based query to fetch specific data from your Optimizely Personalization instance. It lets you retrieve detailed information about various entities.</li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KFKM0ZY369M29NZXG5JXTPGC">Experimentation</h4><p>Released the following <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39681583418125" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Feature Experimentation</a> and <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39682902814605" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Web Experimentation</a> system tools in Optimizely Opal to help you with your Experimentation projects:</p><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef87e81716ad1809b03aeed2366286cab">
<code>exp_get_schemas</code> – Retrieves detailed schemas for various Optimizely entities relevant to Experimentation. This is a mandatory first step before using the <code>exp_execute_query</code> tool to retrieve actual data about these entities.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e06d9fee238854b4ba54134feb1d70694">
<code>exp_execute_query</code> – Executes a template-based query to fetch specific data from your Experimentation instance. It lets you retrieve detailed information about various entities such as feature flags, rules, environments, attributes, and events, based on your specified criteria.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e879b6051354859ffe47df1001d7108bf">
<code>exp_program_reporting_top_experiments</code> – Retrieves experiments that have generated the highest positive or negative lift values within a specified timeframe. It focuses on the performance of individual tests, letting you see which variations of your features are performing best (or worst) against your chosen metrics.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e542e3306813cfe489274c7572ca3c55e">
<code>exp_program_reporting_underperforming_experiments</code> – Helps you identify A/B tests that are not yielding significant or positive results, letting you quickly decide whether to stop, re-evaluate, or iterate on them.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4a307790373716bb86b3cc371fb19dd3">
<code>exp_program_reporting_win_rate</code> – Gives you a high-level overview of the success of your experimentation program by calculating the win rate over a specified period. It is a key metric for understanding the efficiency and impact of your product development cycle.</li>
</ul><h2 id="h_01KFKM99YGZSMYZ03KZH84EJQ7">January 14<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KFKM99YGZSMYZ03KZH84EJQ7"></a></h2><h4 id="h_01KF1MPG062Y6118FWW2YSME84">Opal platform</h4><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5a9766f1504ce2e991e9b37d7c7afd18">Added support for <code>.csv</code> file upload in <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Opal Chat</a> and in <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39407442255245" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">agents</a>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7918ef7d0e873d749fbce5ebe1ea12dc">Added appearance setting (font size and dark mode) for <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39478258680333#h_01KF1G0WNEARVDXYHR9SREDCF4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">users</a> and <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36359944449805#h_01KF1G0WNEARVDXYHR9SREDCF4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">administrators</a>.</li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KF24RDYZ9AY6FEQY8PN0VXR3">Opal Chat</h4><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e10a2c0734f5b140db14ca42b8a3e32c0">Added a toggle to show or hide the Opal Chat history panel. See <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813#h_01K6G1X7PQK0SEP0CG5W9E3620" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Opal Chat user interface through the Opal app</a>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efa860a84fdf0a71121a7bd82e2ed49eb">Updated the Chat input editor and added support for basic Markdown (bold, italics, inline code). See <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Optimizely Opal Chat</a>.</li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KF1CDPAR36J8VFJAKE1EA2YE">Tools</h4><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3e40eb5af50fffecf2b3248c3eb1eb0e">Updated the Opal platform to disable new tools and registries by default, requiring Opal administrators to explicitly enable them.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec4b11757bbcb03905b795134f5280bb3">Released <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/42021008282765" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">system tools for Campaign</a>, helping you easily get information about your Smart campaigns.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebeed1d2d4da081dc2d21fa314cfc2b1b">Updated the <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39340107628429#h_01K7MKZ82913WZJ5N891STHBWS" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><code>analyze_pagespeed</code> tool's </a>results to display the title of the score returned.</li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KF1DCT7D1PJMFB43V3396PW7">Agents</h4><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e7045ad421e15e60580bbe9522ed02a55">Updated <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39417564742797" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">workflow agents</a> to let you add a <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39865892823693" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">trigger</a> to your workflow first.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0e83a1cf2a9f8332fd8b59601c49a7d1">Added the ability to <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39333562134413-Create-specialized-agents#h_01KH79Z1ANFEDE5JX6K22HG5T2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">add existing specialized agent executions as Output Evals</a>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee9d35fb8062c167fc37eae7221967b93">Added <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43420682424077-Specialized-agent-versions" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">versioning</a> in specialized agents, including the ability to <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43420682424077-Specialized-agent-versions#h_01KH4T5S4E20DCCTPPD4R37ANQ" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">view</a> and <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43420682424077-Specialized-agent-versions#h_01KF1XV9Q3MFDRG8PGYVG591SX" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">restore</a> specialized agents to previous versions. You can also <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43420682424077-Specialized-agent-versions#h_01KF1XW31MHW45XXFRDSMXN6ZT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">create a new specialized agent based on a previous version</a>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e74abe204b865d1a7337e3488a4c7c928">Updated the <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39333562134413#h_01K98GV1YGYQXST2AD61884QVS" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>Creativity</strong> selection</a> to a slider and updated the options to not include 0.0.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebd162f99f0294bd7a3a76235896f441d">Updated the <strong>Prompt Template</strong> to include the ability to add variables, tools, and instructions by entering / or [, `, or { respectively. See <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39333562134413#h_01K8KFZ1JVW991P5198GF0QYB0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Additional prompt template configuration</a>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e85490272175874aac61b17291ca1c703">Updated <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39333562134413#h_01K4B9C7ZBERJTHZ1AV7J40NM9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">variables in specialized agents</a>.<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ecaa2e79dd04ccaf4d5d1a39870479755">Variables are now case-insensitive, making it easier for Opal to correctly map variables regardless of casing. For example, <code data-axiom="1.7.1">[[Test]]</code> in the prompt template now matches a variable named <code>test</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e773b88a6963a4454cfa97f3c1e3cbbaa">Variables cannot have duplicate names. So, if you create a variable named <code>test</code>, you cannot add another variable named <code>test</code>, <code>Test</code>, or some other casing of the same variable name. This ensures data integrity and consistency.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e089c2923d63499df2988d976c7a9b060">Updated the tools selection page and added the ability to view a description of the tool before adding it. See <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39333562134413#h_01K4BQ7RXYJMG2NFPM77WKQACA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Define tools</a>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee9397b399a1a0cb708053fc1b8c1be9d">Added a description of the tools listed on the specialized agent page. See <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39333562134413#h_01K4BQ7RXYJMG2NFPM77WKQACA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Define tools</a>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecfca38d7ad18daf93682228a6b9fe9ab">Removed the ability to change an agent's ID for agents installed from the <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39295834770957" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">agent directory</a>, making it easier to update these agents in the future.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec3ede6a1c4b520971fb1fdf60fcf4152">Added a link to the agent on the confirmation pop-up when <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39295797340045#h_01K4MZYVXM5BVNZPXGT8Q0J4JZ" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">installing agents from the agent director</a>, letting you access the agent quickly and review the newly imported agent.</li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KF1F4S807HSVK1T3M59JS40E">Product connections</h4><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3514f52b2c9fbea62d89552eeaf134b4">Added <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/4413200703501" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Optimizely Product Recommendations</a> as an option to select from the <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36359944449805-Get-started-with-Optimizely-Opal-for-administrators#h_01K4N9A8X061YG3ESQKX92K2BZ" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Product connections</a><strong>. </strong>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efefb2c2d8a3ab639a8d1d449b2446c5c">Moved the <strong>Connections</strong> tab to <strong>Settings</strong>. See <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36359944449805-Get-started-with-Optimizely-Opal-for-administrators#h_01K4N9A8X061YG3ESQKX92K2BZ" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Product connections</a><strong>. </strong>
</li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KF1PWM2KS6SJ4ED29DE3ZPTR">Product Information Management (PIM)</h4><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec302fe7ca75ce4d12dd981d604a205be">Released <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/42417538012557" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Opal Chat</a>, letting you interact with Opal from PIM.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e93c9f5eaf114f5cdb3b397282e3b492c">Released <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/42710133223437" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">system tools for PIM</a>, which help you retrieve general statistics from the Dashboard.</li>
</ul><h2 id="h_01KF1Q4KY5HMA98XAE4KKARZCY">January 12<a href="#h_01KAGNKE13M1YX82WRB9CACMZM"></a>
<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KF1Q4KY5HMA98XAE4KKARZCY"></a></h2><h4 id="h_01K9MW5PWNN02NWM3DEMWRTPZ5">Optimizely Reporting for Opal</h4><ul><li data-list-item-id="e617d35b6292dd7722c36e68d1f73fb90">Added <strong>Opal Agent</strong>, the primary agent for chat and feature interaction, to the <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/40917478334093-Optimizely-Reporting-for-Opal#h_01K9MR990W6ZDH2PBTJ2TBY3Z9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Opal Agent Usage</a> dashboard.</li></ul>

          

          

        </section>

<template id="tmpl-article-list">
  <div class="border-top border-bottom lg:border-transparent my-5" x-data="toggle({ isOpen: false })" @collapse:show.stop="open" @collapse:hide.stop="close">

      Categories
      <svg class="fill-current pointer-events-none ml-3" :class="isOpen && 'rotate-180'" width="14px" viewBox="0 0 40 20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <path d="M20,19.5 C19.4,19.5 18.9,19.3 18.4,18.9 L1.4,4.9 C0.3,4 0.2,2.4 1.1,1.4 C2,0.3 3.6,0.2 4.6,1.1 L20,13.8 L35.5,1.1 C36.6,0.2 38.1,0.4 39,1.4 C39.9,2.5 39.7,4 38.7,4.9 L21.7,18.9 C21.1,19.3 20.5,19.5 20,19.5 Z" fill-rule="nonzero"></path>
      </svg>
    </h3>

    <div class="collapse lg:expand lg:flex-column" id="sidebar-article-navigation">
      <ul class="list-unstyled font-size-lg w-full">
        <% categories.forEach(function(category, index) { %>
          <li class="font-semibold" x-data="toggle({ isOpen: <%= !!category.isActive %> })" @collapse:show.stop="open" @collapse:hide.stop="close">

            
            <div class="flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
              <a class="flex-1 py-3 text-inherit" :class="{ 'text-inherit': !isOpen }" href="<%= category.html_url %>">
                <%= category.name %>
              </a>
              <button class="p-2 ml-1 not-a-button border-radius transition cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-200 hidden lg:block" :class="{ 'is-active': isOpen }" :aria-expanded="isOpen" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#category-<%= category.id %>">
                <svg class="text-inherit fill-current pointer-events-none" :class="{ 'rotate-180': isOpen }" width="12px" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 324 190" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
                  <path d="M162,190 C156,190 150,187 146,183 L7,38 C-2,29 -2,15 7,7 C16,-2 30,-2 39,7 L162,135 L285,7 C293,-2 308,-2 317,7 C326,15 326,29 317,38 L178,183 C174,187 168,190 162,190 Z"></path>
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div class="hidden lg:block">
              
              <%= partial('partial-article-list-sections', {
                id: 'category-' + category.id,
                parentId: '#sidebar-article-navigation',
                sections: category.sections,
                activeCategoryId: activeCategoryId,
                activeSectionId: activeSectionId,
                activeArticleId: activeArticleId,
                partial: partial
              }) %>
            </div>
          </li>
        <% }); %>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<template id="tmpl-partial-article-list-sections">
  <% if (sections.length) { %>
    <ul class="list-none pl-3 mb-0 font-size-base collapse" id="<%= id %>" :class="{ 'is-visible': isOpen }" data-parent="<%= parentId %>">
      <% sections.forEach(function(section) { %>
        <li class="font-medium" x-data="toggle({ isOpen: <%= !!section.isActive %> })" @collapse:show.stop="open" @collapse:hide.stop="close">

          
          <div class="flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
            <a class="flex-1 py-2 text-inherit font-semibold" :class="{ 'text-inherit': !isOpen }" href="<%= section.html_url %>">
              <%= section.name %>
            </a>
            <button class="p-2 ml-1 not-a-button border-radius transition cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-200" :class="{ 'is-active': isOpen }" :aria-expanded="isOpen" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#section-<%= section.id %>">
              <svg class="text-inherit fill-current pointer-events-none" :class="{ 'rotate-180': isOpen }" width="12px" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 324 190" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
                <path d="M162,190 C156,190 150,187 146,183 L7,38 C-2,29 -2,15 7,7 C16,-2 30,-2 39,7 L162,135 L285,7 C293,-2 308,-2 317,7 C326,15 326,29 317,38 L178,183 C174,187 168,190 162,190 Z"></path>
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>

          
          <%= partial('partial-article-list-sections', {
            id: 'section-' + section.id,
            parentId: '#' + id,
            sections: section.sections,
            activeCategoryId: activeCategoryId,
            activeSectionId: activeSectionId,
            activeArticleId: activeArticleId,
            partial: partial
          }) %>

          
          <% if (section.articles.length) { %>
            <ul class="list-none font-size-md pl-0 mb-0 collapse" :class="{ 'is-visible': isOpen }" id="section-<%= section.id %>" data-parent="#<%= id %>">
              <% section.articles.forEach(function(article) { %>
                <li>
                  <a class="block px-3 py-2 text-inherit border-radius transition<% if (article.isActive) { %> bg-gray-100<% } %>" href="<%= article.html_url %>">
                    <%= article.title %>
                  </a>
                </li>
              <% }); %>
            </ul>
          <% } %>

        </li>
      <% }); %>
    </ul>
  <% } %>
</template>


<template id="tmpl-partial-section-list-sections">
  <% if (sections.length) { %>
    <ul class="list-unstyled font-size-md<% if (parent.hasOwnProperty('parent_section_id')) { %> pl-4 mb-0<% } %>">
      <% sections.slice(0, maxSections).forEach(function(section) { %>
        <li>
          <a class="block py-2 text-inherit<% if (section.isActive) { %> border-left border-left-primary border-left-4 -ml-4 pl-3<% } %>" href="<%= section.html_url %>">
            <%= section.name %>
          </a>
          <%= partial('partial-section-list-sections', { parent: section, sections: section.sections, maxSections: maxSections, partial: partial }) %>
        </li>
      <% }); %>
      <% if (sections.length > maxSections) { %>
        <li>
          <a class="block py-2 text-inherit" href="<%= parent.html_url %>">
            See more
          </a>
        </li>
      <% } %>
    </ul>
  <% } %>
</template>

BodyMarkdown:
2026 Optimizely Opal release notes – Support Help Center                   

[Skip to main content](#page-container)

Follow this article to receive email notifications when content is added to Optimizely Opal for 2026.

## June 30[](#h_01KSJMXV0N3QE3JFVMQYT1Z90Q)

#### Opal Agent Usage dashboard

*   Released a new version of the **Opal Agent Usage** dashboard, which gives organizations a centralized dashboard for Opal agent usage so administrators can track executions, monitor credit consumption, and see which agents and users are most active. The updated dashboard displays summary cards, an execution-type breakdown, agent and top-user tables, and weekly active-user trends over your selected time period. See [Optimizely Reporting for Opal](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/40917478334093-Optimizely-Reporting-for-Opal) for more information.

#### Opal platform

*   Released the [Agent Library](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46841075475853-Agent-Library), a browsable catalog on the Opal Chat homepage where you can find and launch more than 45 pre-built agents in one click, so discovering the right agent no longer means knowing where to look.
*   Released [Personalize Opal](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46923254602253), a pinned onboarding agent that walks you through connecting your tools and building skills in a guided, role-based session, so you get value from Chat in your first few minutes.
*   Added agent sharing and visibility controls, which let you keep an agent private or share it with named people or your whole organization, with permission levels that govern who can view, run, edit, or delete each agent. New agents default to private on instances where the feature is enabled (not available on all tiers). See [Share agents and manage visibility](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46955665143309-Share-agents-and-manage-visibility).
*   Released an image editor in Opal Chat, which lets you refine a generated image without starting over by detecting and selecting visual elements, transforming them with brush controls, queuing batch edits, and applying smart aspect ratios, so you generate and fine-tune images in one place. See [Image generation](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46923547617421-Image-generation).
*   Released the [Skills builder](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46215744677133-Skills-builder) for general availability, which lets you create and manage reusable skills that agents draw on, so you tailor Opal to your own workflows.
*   Added the ability to export workflow agent execution logs to comma-separated values (CSV) or Excel with date-range filtering, and added the same date-range selection to specialized agent log exports, so you can pull an audit trail on demand for performance tracking and compliance. See [Workflow agent logs](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43421534871949-Workflow-agent-logs) and [Specialized agent logs](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43420950339725-Specialized-agent-logs).

#### Agents

Released the following agents:

*   [Meeting Notes Summary agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46747885873421-Meeting-Notes-Summary-agent) – Turns raw notes or a transcript into a shareable one-page summary of decisions, owner-assigned action items, and open questions, so nothing from a meeting gets lost.
*   [Meeting Follow-up Email agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/47000128111629-Meeting-Follow-up-Email-agent) – Turns meeting notes into a ready-to-send email covering decisions, action items with named owners, and next steps, so you send a clear recap in minutes.
*   [Meeting Preparation agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/47000357635725-Meeting-Preparation-agent) – Turns your agenda, prior notes, and attendees into a one-page brief you can read in under two minutes, covering the goal, key context, talking points, and decisions to make, so you walk in prepared.
*   [Newsletter Body Editor agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46960991126029-Newsletter-Body-Editor-agent) – Drafts engaging email body copy from a topic, audience, and brand voice, so you go from brief to on-brand draft in one step. See 
*   [Email Ideation agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46944502030861-Email-Ideation-agent) –  Brainstorms five to seven newsletter themes and content angles tailored to your niche and goals, so you start from ideas instead of a blank brief.
*   [Email Subject and Preview Text Generation agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46944544517901) – Generates paired subject lines and preview text optimized for specific psychological triggers, so you have ready-to-test copy that can lift open rates. 
*   [Email Performance Comparison agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46956972020237) – Compares past and current email campaigns across key performance indicators (KPIs) to surface what drove results, so you can repeat what works in your next send.
*   [LinkedIn Ad Brief Generation agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46750426959117-LinkedIn-Ad-Brief-Generation-agent) – Builds a complete LinkedIn ad brief from a product name and URL, with copy variants, ranked call-to-action (CTA) options, and an optional competitor benchmark that all fit LinkedIn's character limits, so copy is ready to paste into Campaign Manager.
*   [Presentation Outline Generation agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46857076042253) – Turns a topic, audience, and goal into a slide-by-slide outline with key messages, suggested content, and speaker notes, so you build a deck from structure instead of a blank page.
*   [Webinar Outline agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46933858457869-Webinar-Outline-agent) – Turns a topic and optional notes into a ready-to-run outline with timed sections, talking points, engagement moments, and pre- and post-event checklists tuned to your goal and duration, so you can plan a webinar end to end.
*   [Social Media Image Generation agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46962859059981-Social-Media-Image-Generation-agent) – Generates correctly sized, platform-ready images for LinkedIn, Meta, X, display ads, and email from a text prompt or a reference image, so visuals stay on-brand without resizing guesswork.
*   [Image Resizer agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46931589943181-Image-Resizer-agent) – Resizes an uploaded image to exact specifications for LinkedIn, Instagram, Meta, X, Google Display, email headers, and web banners from preset names or custom dimensions, so every format comes back ready to use in one place. 
*   [Image Text Remover agent](/hc/en-us/articles/46944458102669) – Removes overlaid text such as captions or burnt-in subtitles from an uploaded image and fills the cleared area with the surrounding background, so you can reuse an image without its original text.
*   [Image Metadata Ideation agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46961312446989) – Analyzes email content from Optimizely Campaign to suggest accessible alt text and titles for images, so your emails stay accessible and compliant. Requires Optimizely Campaign.
*   [Case Study Generation agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46930101538445-Case-Study-Generation-agent) – Produces a publication-ready B2B SaaS case study from a company name and background material such as interview notes or a transcript, complete with cited metrics, verbatim quotes, and before-and-after results, so you turn raw inputs into a polished study fast. 
*   [Image Alt Text Generation agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46917259336845-Image-Alt-Text-Generation-agent) – Audits up to 20 images on any page URL, scores existing alt text against Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 AA, and returns ready-to-use copy with a prioritized fix list, so you meet accessibility standards and strengthen search engine optimization (SEO) without checking images by hand. 
*   [Agent Visibility Analytics Insights agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46601296438285-Agent-Visibility-Analytics-Insights-agent) – Examines your Agent Visibility Analytics dashboard to surface trends, anomalies, and recommended actions based on a chosen analysis framework, so you find insights without digging through the data yourself. 
*   [Page Builder agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46958713473165-Page-Builder-agent) – analyzes a document, image, or URL and creates a CMS (SaaS) content item of a chosen content type following best practices, so editors move from idea to finished content quickly.
*   [Content Analysis agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46958664813965-Content-Analysis-agent) – Analyzes a content type to find structural patterns and best practices and returns an instruction set you can feed into the Page Builder agent, so generated content matches your CMS (SaaS) conventions. 
*   [Content Model Creation agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/47006419478925-Content-Model-Creation-agent-CMS-13). – Analyzes URLs or images to build best-practice content models and references existing models to prevent duplicates, so your content architecture stays consistent in CMS 13 (PaaS). 
*   [GEO Schema Optimization agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/47005663981837-GEO-Schema-Optimization-CMS-13) – Analyzes page content and recommends or generates schema types and JSON-LD markup, so your content in CMS 13 (PaaS) is more discoverable across search engines and large language models (LLMs).
*   [SEO Metadata Optimization agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/47005376544141-SEO-Metadata-Implementation-agent-CMS-13) – Analyzes webpages and generates optimized meta titles, descriptions, and OpenGraph tags, then applies them as drafts in CMS 13 (PaaS), so you improve search rankings without manual edits
*   [Conductor AEO Gap Finder agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46540556098189) –  Finds high-priority Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) content gaps by analyzing your website against tracked competitors.
*   [Conductor AI Brand Visibility Report agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46519306662029) – Delivers a snapshot of your brand's visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
*   [Conductor Competitive AI Share of Voice agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46541477285389) – Compares your brand against tracked competitors across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. Share of voice measures how often AI engines mention your brand compared to competitors.

#### Tools

*   Added [Zoom Meetings](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/45589352021261) connector tools, which connects Opal to your Zoom meetings so agents can work with meeting content.
*   Added additional [system tools for Optimizely Data Platform (ODP)](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/42165689708813).

#### CMS 13 Tools

Released tools to help you work with display templates and upload media. See [Display template tools](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/content-management-system/v13.0.0-CMS/docs/available-tools#display-template-tools) and [Media tool](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/content-management-system/v13.0.0-CMS/docs/available-tools#media-tool).

*   `paas_cms_list_display_templates` – Lists all display templates. Takes no parameters.
*   `paas_cms_get_display_template` – Retrieves one or more display templates by key. 
*   `paas_cms_create_display_template` – Creates a display template. Scope the template to exactly one of `NodeType`, `BaseType`, or `ContentType`.
*   `paas_cms_update_display_template` – Updates an existing display template. Only provided fields are updated. Omitted fields are unchanged.
*   `paas_cms_upload_media` – Downloads a file from a publicly accessible URL and uploads it as a media asset in CMS.

## June 24[](#h_01KWCHWTRNGRJEG10RC11HMQA6)

#### Opal platform

*   Added bulk delete, which lets you select multiple [chat threads](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813-Optimizely-Opal-Chat#h_01JTFFCARH1X3RGXC9C42RKPC9), [specialized agents](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43420242726925-Manage-specialized-agents#h_01KVXMXGM313W6BMK08SHJM9XE), [workflow agents](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43421467541645-Manage-workflow-agents#h_01KVV4XETHD5PHZZE7B5P9YJN7), or [skills](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36553454584077-Manage-skills#h_01KVXNHXV3J1VHD4VD7G8ZXHEQ) and remove them in one action.
*   Added model provider selection at the [instance](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36359944449805-Get-started-with-Optimizely-Opal-for-administrators#h_01KVV0V475SGJJWP4E9RXJFW6C) and [specialized agent](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39333562134413-Create-a-specialized-agent#h_01K98GRXG35B3Q8EE8TAJ6E7PS) level, letting you choose the model that best fits each use case.

#### Opal Chat

*   Updated the activity stream so you can follow what Opal does while it responds:
    *   Added inline tool status, which shows the tools Opal uses in real time.
    *   Added context pickup pills, which show the context Opal pulls into a response. See [Optimizely Opal Chat](/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813).
*   Added equation rendering, so mathematical formulas and equations display as formatted notation instead of plain text in chat messages. See [Equation display](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813-Optimizely-Opal-Chat#h_01EQDISPLAY).
*   Added a keyboard shortcut that stops a response when you press Escape, so you can halt Opal without clicking **Stop**. See [Stop a response](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813-Optimizely-Opal-Chat#h_01STOPRESP).

#### Agents

*   Added execution-log export for [specialized](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43420950339725-Specialized-agent-logs#h_01KF1RYXGK6ZMHPX0STN7K1BQH) and [workflow](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/43421534871949-Workflow-agent-logs#h_01KAH2H17SR0PB91DE5PDXZGA1) agents, so you can export a custom date range to analyze run history.
*   Added skill preview in the agent editor, so you can review what a skill does before adding it. See [Skills](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39300056376717-Prompt-details-for-specialized-agents#h_skills) in the Prompt details documentation.

#### Skills

*   Added skill watching, so you receive a notification when another user updates or deletes a skill you watch. See [Watchers](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36353487109133-Skills-overview#h_01SKILLWATCHERS).
*   Added skill import and export, which lets you reuse skills across instances or keep an external backup. See [Import and export skills](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46896622603917-Import-and-export-skills).
*   Added a scope switcher to the skills, which lets Opal Administrators move a skill between Personal and Organization without recreating it. If the shortcut is already in use, Opal appends `-personal` or `-org` so it stays unique. See [Switch a skill between personal and organization](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36553454584077-Manage-skills#h_01KVX93PX965XZ4REVAPTM1JNN).
*   Added file attachment support to the skill creation tool, so agents can attach files when building skills for you. See the [Skills management](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39340107628429-System-tools-overview#h_01K7MKZ82913WZJ5N891STHBWS) tools.

#### RAG for CMP

*   Improved retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) asset search for Content Marketing Platform (CMP), which lets you [filter assets by library folder name or path](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/40604966361997-RAG-for-Content-Marketing-Platform-CMP#h_rag_limitations). Opal returns content from the folder you specify, giving more precise results. 
*   Added [relevancy explanations](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/40604966361997-RAG-for-Content-Marketing-Platform-CMP#h_01KVXRFH92ZBVWZN4NXW1YMGF5) to the assets Opal suggests from your content library. Each explanation shows why Opal selected the asset, helping you decide whether it fits your request. 
*   Released RAG support in the European Union (EU) region. Customers with EU data residency requirements can now use RAG while Optimizely keeps their CMP data within EU-based infrastructure. See [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) overview](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/40191922084493-Retrieval-Augmented-Generation-RAG-overview) for information.

## June 1[](#h_01KT9H2HTZ38DY793X6A8XR9QS)

**Quality tab** – Released the Quality tab for specialized agents. Use it to score every run, detect drift from established behavior, and recover runs that go wrong. This means you can scale agents across your organization without manually reviewing every execution. The Quality tab contains the following three features:

*   **Output Evaluation** uses an AI model to score each run against criteria you define. Configure up to 10 evaluation criteria and a baseline evaluation score between 75% and 95% in 5% increments. Provide up to five output examples or conversation samples that represent expected quality.
*   **Execution Guardrails** detect runs that deviate from your agent's normal behavior. The guardrails progress through Learning, Watching, and Enforcing modes based on successful runs observed. You control sensitivity and whether Opal stops flagged runs automatically.
*   **Execution Advisor** recovers flagged runs with corrective guidance and retries failed tool calls with adjusted input. It also reviews sensitive tool calls (such as email, publish, or delete) with inline **Approved** or **Blocked** verdicts.

See [Quality tab overview](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/46195603210125-Quality-tab-overview) for details.

#### CMS 13

Released tools to help you create and manage content and content types, optimize for search engines, and improve AI discoverability. See [Available tools for CMS 13](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/content-management-system/v13.0.0-CMS/docs/available-tools).

*   `paas_cms_list_content_types` – Lists all content types in CMS.
*   `paas_cms_get_content_type_details` – Retrieves detailed information about a specific content type, including all property definitions with types, validation rules, and group assignments.
*   `paas_cms_create_content_type` – Creates a new content type with a key, display name, base type, and property definitions.
*   `paas_cms_update_content_type` – Modifies an existing content type's display name, description, or property definitions.
*   `paas_cms_delete_content_type` – Deletes a content type from CMS. The content type must not have any existing content instances.
*   `paas_cms_list_property_groups` – Lists all property groups in the CMS with their names and sort order.
*   `paas_cms_create_property_group` – Creates a new property group with a unique key and optional sort order.
*   `paas_cms_get_content_data` – Retrieves a content item's data including all non-metadata properties. Fetches a specific version or the latest published version.
*   `paas_cms_update_content_item` – Updates properties on a content item. Accepts a JSON object of property name and value pairs. If no `contentkey` is specified, creates a new content item as a draft. Returns a `contentKey` (GUID) and `contentVersion` for subsequent operations.
*   `paas_cms_delete_content_item` – Moves a content item to the waste basket. An editor can restore the item.
*   `paas_cms_publish_content_item` – Publishes a content item immediately or schedules it for a future date and time. Requires a content version number.
*   `paas_cms_create_content_variation` – Creates a new locale variation of a page or experience content item.
*   `paas_cms_get_content_preview_url` – Generates a preview URL for a specific content version, letting Opal fetch and analyze the rendered HTML.
*   `paas_cms_seo_analysis` – Analyzes content SEO performance and provides AI-powered recommendations.
*   `paas_cms_seo_edit` – Applies SEO recommendations to CMS content.
*   `paas_cms_geo_analysis` – Performs an AI-powered audit of content for LLM discoverability.
*   `paas_cms_geo_apply` – Applies JSON-LD schema templates to the content's `JsonLdTemplates` property. Creates a new draft version with the schema markup.
